privacy.ai_training_note: LawGeex trains its AI on customer contract data through their Managed AI approach. Every contract reviewed includes a Legal QA process that feeds learnings, new concepts, and contract types back into the system for continuous algorithm improvement. The system has been trained on millions of contracts. However, the vendor does not explicitly disclose whether customer data is isolated per-client or pooled for broader training, and does not provide clear opt-out mechanisms for customers who wish to prevent their contract data from being used for AI training. This is a material concern for a platform processing confidential legal documents.

products.name: LawGeex
products.data_scope: Enterprise contracts, NDAs, commercial agreements; processes legally sensitive documents
products.notes: Primary product for large enterprise customers. Patented AI technology trained on millions of contracts. Uses Digital Playbook, AI analytics, and Managed AI approach combining human lawyers with machine learning. Claimed 80% time savings, 3x faster deal closing, 90% cost reduction vs manual review. NOTE: Enterprise client base largely acquired by LegalSifter and Robin AI in 2023.

Same founders (Noory Bechor, Ilan Admon) who built LawGeex. Focuses on deal closing speed and cost reduction for non-enterprise customers.

flags: OVER-CLAIM RISK: Third-party vendor profile (Nudge Security) lists SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR certifications that are NOT independently verified on LawGeex's official security page or website. Cannot confirm these certifications held.

AI TRAINING DATA: LawGeex trains AI models on customer contract data without explicit disclosure of data isolation per-client or opt-out mechanisms. Material privacy concern for platform processing confidential legal documents (NDAs, M&A, etc.).

COMPANY RESTRUCTURING: Enterprise client base substantially divested in 2023 (LegalSifter and Robin AI acquisitions). Current product roadmap and long-term viability of LawGeex (vs. new Superlegal product) uncertain.
OUTDATED TERMS: Terms of Use last updated January 21, 2016 (10 years old). Does not reflect current company structure, AI capabilities, or 2024 data protection practices.
DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT: Privacy policy references DPA but does not provide public link or template; must contact vendor for execution.

NO EXPLICIT GDPR COMPLIANCE STATEMENT: While privacy policy references GDPR roles, no formal GDPR compliance attestation, adequacy certification, or Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) publicly documented.

IDENTITY CLARIFICATION NEEDED: Vendor is Legalogic Ltd. (Israel-headquartered) but operates under 'LawGeex' brand; post-2023 divestitures, unclear which entities retain which product lines and liabilities.
